_meta.note: Authored skill ABSORPTIONS (decisions #34 + #35 Q2, owner 2026-08-18; docs/design/skill-tiers-proposal.md RULED — the 4 ABSORB stamps §2). ABSORB = consume ONE compatible lesser skill (the FODDER) to push the SURVIVOR into its L6-8 band — cheaper than a merge, the survivor keeps its identity. RULED SEMANTICS (Q2): the unlock is FLAT — owning the fodder at the authored minimum unlocks the whole L6-8 band regardless of how far past that minimum the fodder was ('flat unlock + min-fodder' is the recorded reading of the ruling; flagged for correction if 'levels convert' was intended). The minimum fodder level is authored PER ABSORB PAIR (mirroring Q5's per-recipe spirit), per the owner's fairness rationale: 'it might be unfair depending on skill stat dependency' — so the minimum is HIGHER where the fodder is stat-cheap (single-stat fodder levels from one trait pool: min 4) and lower where it is stat-expensive (two-stat fodder pays a point from EACH listed stat per level: min 3, the merge-secondary echo). ALL min_fodder_level values are PROVISIONAL awaiting owner sign-off. Legality is strictly NARROW keyword share (G3) — absorbs have NO override tier; a broad-only pair is Mod-Center offer scope (data/mod_center_offers.json), never an absorb. One absorb per survivor, ever (the flat band unlocks once). ENGINE: simulation/skill_forge.gd validate_absorption/apply_absorption — pure, all-violations-at-once; the survivor's roster row gains {absorbed: <fodder key>, cap: 8} and the fodder row is removed. Those are ROSTER-LAYER annotations (the recruit_loadouts cap/cap_note precedent): CombatantState.from_spec normalizes combat rows to {key, level} and DROPS them by design — combat needs only the grant; the absorb bookkeeping lives in progression data. LEVELING the unlocked band (who pays what to go 6->7->8) is KAN-7 pricing scope, untouched here. The bonus mapping below records which authored L5+ threshold row becomes the survivor's L6 absorb bonus (tier proposal §3 appendix — nothing discarded).
_meta.schema: absorption: { key (unique, = the survivor's skill key), survivor: {key, min_level} (the past-5 moment — authored per absorption, Q5 spirit; Lv 5 = mastery of the base form), fodder: [{key, min_fodder_level, rationale}] (1-2 authored candidates, each verified narrow-compatible with the survivor; min_fodder_level PROVISIONAL, authored per pair), unlock: { cap: 8 (the flat L6-8 band), bonus: {threshold_id, level: 6, note} (the re-mapped L6 absorb bonus — skill_thresholds.json row) }, note }
